authorized_actions: Create one non-recursive immutable snapshot containing exactly the six candidate-bound artifacts, the candidate and its verification receipt.
Create a sorted fixed-timestamp ZIP and SHA-256 manifest.
Restore into a newly created empty temporary directory and verify exact path set, bytes and SHA-256.
Parse the five JSON and two YAML files and perform name, status and runtime-authority static checks only.
Verify that the three active terminology and consistency locks remain byte-identical to the recorded baseline.
Create an acceptance record only if every authorized static check passes.
Create a local Git commit without a remote.
not_authorized: Editing or activating .light/terminology.md or either active consistency lock.
Activating the candidate consistency locks or runtime-authority manifest.
Executing tests or importing production, analysis, optimizer or evaluator modules.
Changing production, analysis or existing test implementation.
Installing or downloading packages or source.
Calling an objective, constraint, benchmark, optimizer or evaluator.
Reading or analyzing formal result packages.
Executing S6-E0, M, C1, F, C2, Stage B or formal FFE.
Freezing NV, BM or SA by inference.
Forming performance, novelty, robustness or paper-readiness conclusions.
Remote push, public release or submission.
